' CHAAT '  KATCHORIS
By: Usha Chowdhary Gupta
Published: Sunday, September 18, 2011 - 6:20am

Ingredients




4-5 KATCHORIS,
[ recipe of katchoris as per Besan katchoris ] ,
1 CUP CURD,
[ BEATEN SMOOTH WITH SALT, RED CHILLY,
SUGAR AND CUMIN POWDER.]
ONION AND POTATO CUT,
GREEN CHUTNEY, SWEET CHUTNEY,
SOME CORIANDER AND SEV TO SPRINKLE ON TOP.

Preparation

1 ON THE TOP OF THE KATCHORIS BREAK IT. 2 FILL IT WITH SOME CUT ONION AND POTATO PIECES. 3 SPRINKLE SOME CURD, GREEN CHUTNEY AND SWEET 4 CHUTNEY. ON TOP GARNISH WITH SEV AND CORIANDER LEAVES.
